system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. This skill only produces an effect when you are equipped with a [Shield]. The damage you take from «Protect» and «Take Over» is reduced by [SRx8].

(SR2): Increase your [Attack Power] by +[STR mod].
(SR3): One shield you are equipped with increases its [Physical Defense] by +[INT mod].

A fighting style that skillfully combines weapon and shield techniques and applies them to attacks. Its defensiveness shows its true value when protecting allies.
